name: komdosh-dev-spring-core
description: Must-have foundation for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux/coroutines services. Ships 15 agents, 10 slash commands, 8 mandatory skills, 10 rule documents, and 1 post-edit hook — enforcing hexagonal architecture, coroutine safety, RFC 9457 error semantics, and the persistence/observability/testing conventions every consumer service needs. Other capabilities (events, QA artifact generation, vendor-decoupling, dep upgrader, flake detector) ship as separate plugins in the same marketplace.
